caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a metallic stand with a three-legged base. The stand rises vertically from the center, splitting at the base into three slightly curved feet for stability. About two-thirds of the way up, there is an extended arm that projects horizontally and then curves downward. At the top end of the stand, the arm supports a small cylindrical cup or holder. The object appears to be made of dark metal, as indicated by the shading and texture in the drawing. The background is plain and off-white, with a slightly yellowed appearance, possibly due to the age of the paper. The artwork is bordered by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular line. The artist's signature, "Bernard Watkinscott," appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing. There are a few small brown spots, likely due to staining or aging, present on the paper, but the focus remains on the central illustrated object.
title: Candle Holder
